knowledge_point.title: Identifying Correct Statements About a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
- $A$ is upper triangular: **false**. The entry in row 2, column 1 is $2\ne 0$, below the main diagonal.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

- $A$ is lower triangular: **true**. All entries above the main diagonal are zero.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

- ${A}^{T}$ is upper triangular: **true**. All entries below the main diagonal are zero.

$$
{A}^{T}=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$
